blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— The International Criminal Court (ICC) has given the signal to the prosecution to admit as evidence the witness testimony that is said to have proof on the operations of the Davao Death Squad (DDS). The prosecution claimed that the scheme was allegedly the brainchild of former President Rodrigo Duterte.
